test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight people, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a dining table. D is the brother of E. G's wife F. B is A's wife. C is married to H. A is C's brother. F is the father-in-law of B. C is the father of his only son D. How is A related to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: Eight people, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a dining table.

1) D is the brother of E. 

2) C is the father of his only son D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e76bf464a4dde6e386d6ac305412800c1b920827b7faf75a3e351b30f7529d51.png] 

3) C is married to H.

4) A is C's brother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c25943ee6c15de2297a2c2f16d469d25791d7bbb49fe690ba194cf7a7610ed8.png] 

5) B is A's wife.

6) F is the father-in-law of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2afeb5373b04c40f3a4d434cefc0b634494d5e141e9580c8941c3f76cc2e2ebc.png] 

Thus, A is D's paternal uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
